headline: NATO will defend every inch of Polish territory, says Rutte
summary: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte said the alliance will defend every inch of Polish territory. Drones have repeatedly entered airspace of NATO's eastern flank during Russia's war in Ukraine.
why: NATO's collective defense posture and eastern-flank deployments affect defense spending, regional security risk and European markets.
original_headline: OTAN defenderá cada pulgada del territorio polaco, afirma Rutte
